seen.where: Groninger Archieven toegang 835 inv. 256 EAD record (OAI feed, 14 Nov 2026): the manuscript has a deciphered copy by W.B.S. Boeles bound in; web search 14 Nov 2026 found the edition J. van den Broek, Het geheime dagboek van de Groninger stadssecretaris Johan Julsing 1589-1594 (Groninger Bronnen Reeks 2, 2006), reviewed in BMGN, and a Boeles selection of 1866. The edition itself was not opened.

2696.closed: The diary has a decipherment bound with it (Boeles) and is printed in full in Van den Broek's 2006 edition (Groninger Bronnen Reeks 2, found by web search and a BMGN review). The 'geheim' text is a private multilingual diary with Hebrew-letter words per the inventory, so it is read, not an open ciphertext. The edition was not opened to check the nature of the script.
